description: Use this when the user names a child care center, preschool or family child care home (by name, license number, or name and city) in a covered US state and wants its official state licensing or inspection record. Returns up to 10 matching facilities with street, ZIP and license number so the right one can be confirmed, plus a record_key for get_facility_record. Do not use it for general child care advice, to rank or recommend facilities, or for information about individual people.

city.description: Optional city name to narrow the results to.

query.description: Facility name, part of a name, or the agency license number, as the user typed it.

state.description: Two-letter US state code (for example TX) of the state whose records to read. If the state is not covered, the tool returns an error naming the covered states.

name: find_facility
title: Find a child care facility
